2607.19718.title: Lightweight Person-Place Relation Extraction from Historical Newspapers with Dependency Graphs and Proximity Features
2607.19718.paper_summary: The HIPE-2026 shared task introduces person-place relation extraction from multilingual historical newspapers as a new evaluation track, classifying the at and isAt relations between pre-annotated person and location mentions in English, French, and German. Motivated by the cost of processing historical archives at scale, our team (DS@GT HIPE, team 2 in the official results) investigates how far a lightweight, interpretable system can go without any pretrained language model at the relation classification stage. Our approach builds a document-level graph from dependency parses, extracts proximity-based and part-of-speech features for each entity pair, and classifies them with small scikit-learn ensembles or compact Graph Attention Networks, keeping every submitted run under 847K parameters. On the official evaluation (Test A, the newspaper test set), our best run reached a macro recall of 0.5142, ranking 3rd on the Efficiency profile while placing mid-table on Accuracy among the 17 participating teams. Two findings stand out. First, minimum character distance alone captures most of the classification signal; adding further engineered features yields inconsistent gains and sometimes degrades performance, echoing prior evidence that argument distance dominates relation extraction. Second, document-grouped cross-validation is essential on this corpus: pair-level splits inflate scores by 25-37 percentage points because entity mentions recur across documents, a data-leakage effect that grouped cross-validation removes.
2607.19718.paper_summary_zh: HIPE-2026 共享任務引入了從多語言歷史報紙中提取人-地點關係作為一個新的評估路徑，對英語、法語和德語中預標註的人物和地點提及之間的 at 和 isAt 關係進行分類。由於處理歷史檔案的成本，我們的團隊（DS@GT HIPE，官方結果中的第 2 隊）研究了一個輕量級、可解釋的系統在關係分類階段不使用任何預訓練語言模型能走多遠。我們的方法從依賴解析中構建文檔級圖，提取每對實體的基於接近度和詞性特徵，並使用小型 scikit-learn 集成或緊湊的圖注意力網絡進行分類，保持每個提交的運行在 847K 參數以內。在官方評估（測試 A，報紙測試集）中，我們的最佳運行達到了 0.5142 的宏觀召回率，在效率概況中排名第 3，而在 17 支參賽隊伍中準確率則位於中游。兩個發現特別突出。首先，最小字符距離本身捕捉了大部分的分類信號；添加進一步工程化的特徵會產生不一致的增益，有時甚至會降低性能，呼應了先前的證據，即論證距離主導關係提取。其次，文檔分組的交叉驗證在這個語料庫中至關重要：對於成對級別的拆分，由於實體提及在文檔中重複，得分會膨脹 25-37 個百分點，這是一種數據洩漏效應，而分組交叉驗證則消除了這一問題。
